items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I knew of Zutty and I was told about Zutty. I missed Zutty because Zutty had left by the time I was traveling around on circuses and carnivals

ctx.x: At the Savoy Ballroom. It happened the same night that Mr. Benny Goodman was playing at Carnegie Hall, doing his jazz concert, because Zutty, Gene Krupa, came up at the battle. Meanwhile I went down with the Basie rhythm section to play with Benny at Carnegie Hall, but Walter Page, Freddie, and Basie played in the Benny band. I did not. And Buck played. It's on the records that they finally re-issued. This is January 1937. But after the concert I went on back up to the place, but after the concert we got in a…
